name: The Super Snapper FX
summary: Curgle Cranklehop has a new device for you to try: the Super Snapper FX. Aim it at Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands, then bring the picture and device to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village. This follows The Borrower.

sections.title: A Device to Test
sections.body: After The Borrower, Curgle Cranklehop puts a new invention in your hands: the Super Snapper FX. Aim it at what you want pictured, then press the button. Curgle gives it to you to try.

sections.title: The Subject
sections.body: Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands, is the subject you mentioned to Curgle. He wishes you luck in finding her and expects Daryn Lightwind to be pleased with the snapshot. Once you have the picture, bring it and the device to Daryn in Rut'theran Village.

faq.q: Who gives the Super Snapper FX?
aliases: where to get super snapper fx
faq.answer: Curgle Cranklehop gives you the Super Snapper FX to try.

faq.q: What do I photograph with the Super Snapper FX?
faq.answer: Photograph Gammerita, a creature from the Hinterlands. Curgle wishes you luck finding her.
Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village receives both the snapshot and the device.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: The chain continues with Return to Troyas.
